claims.claim: Gear reducer 15 to 20hp cast bodies types
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a blue cylindrical industrial unit with flanged/mounting base and a yellow end/shaft/coupling area, but no readable make/model, nameplate, gear ratio, or horsepower rating is visible.

risks.risk: Cannot confirm the exact type (gear reducer vs other cylindrical industrial component) or internal gearing; photos don’t show markings or functional indicators.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the nameplate/label (brand, model, gear ratio, input/output specs) and any stamped markings on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-verified industrial reducer/gearbox component (worst-case: unknown specs), with a discount for unknown internal condition.

risks.risk: Horsepower rating (15–20hp) may be incorrect or not matching the unit shown; without a nameplate, the rating can’t be trusted.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate showing HP/kW rating and input speed (RPM) and output speed (RPM).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case assumption (rating unknown/not guaranteed), treating it as not confirmed for 15–20hp use.

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (may be seized, noisy, leaking, or missing seals/bearings). Photos only show external appearance.
risks.proof: Short video clip of the unit running under load or at least a spin test showing smooth rotation, plus a leak check (no oil seepage) around seals/flanges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested/unknown working condition' (worst-case: may require overhaul).

risks.risk: Yellow end part could be a coupling/shaft/protective cover; its condition and whether it’s complete (no missing key/shaft damage) is not verifiable.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the yellow end with keyway/shaft details (if present), and a shot showing the mating interface clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible wear/damage or missing interface details; treat as 'may need parts' until confirmed.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/mounting hardware and uncertain dimensions/weight; base plate bolts are visible but completeness isn’t.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included items (mounting bolts, couplings, guards, manuals) laid out, and a tape-measure shot of key dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming included hardware; treat as 'unit only' unless accessories are shown.

proof_requests: Clear, readable nameplate/rating plate photo (brand, model, gear ratio, input/output RPM, HP/kW rating).
Video clip of the unit running (or at minimum a smooth manual rotation/spin test) showing no grinding and no abnormal noise.
Close-up of the yellow end interface (shaft/coupling) showing keyway/condition and whether any parts are missing.
Photos of seals/flanges for oil leakage and a shot of the underside/base for seepage.
Photos of any included mounting hardware/accessories and a tape-measure shot of overall dimensions.
response.reason: The witness confirms an external cylindrical industrial component consistent with a reducer, but the critical details needed to price it safely (make/model, ratings, gear ratio, and working condition) are not readable or shown. Without those, any price would be guesswork.
